liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (2 reviews): The jam into The Other One blew the reviewer away; Sequence from Truckin' to One More Saturday Night is superb [21][26]
- **On the Road Again** (1 review): Transitioned seamlessly into Beat It On Down the Line, described as precise [16]
- **West LA Fadeaway** (1 review): First performance of this song on the west coast [24]
- **Deal** (1 review): Jerry kicked into a rousing performance after The Music Never Stopped [18]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): The middle jam is described as the best ever [23]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer expressed amazement at the effects used during this segment [25]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Considered one of the best performances of this song ever recorded [16]

## The recordings

- **gd82-10-09.sbd.samaritano.23730.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 158 min; rated 4.44/5 by 9 [1]
- **gd1982-10-09.mtx.seamons.93811.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1982-10-09.167455.shure.sm57.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 157 min [3]
- **gd82-10-09.sonyecm.clugston.5183.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 23 songs; 153 min; rated 4.79/5 by 14 [5]. Said about its sound: Phil's definition slightly lacking, but balance is nice and very clear [18]
- **gd1982-10-09.nak700.anon-poris.LMPP.95656.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 155 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Nice solid, clear recording; very full, up front, and a great listen [7]
- **gd82-10-09.sbd-patched.wiley.15800.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 149 min; rated 4.48/5 by 23 [12]. Said about its sound: Bass drum kicks cause frequency drops beyond tape range late in the show [26]

## Around the show

- Nice sunny day at the lawn amphitheater venue [16]
- Listener's first show; energy of Estimated Prophet to Eyes of World stood out [17]
- Phil was smiling a lot and Bobby flirted with girls in the front row [24]
- Listener's first show; Frost Amphitheatre holds a special place in their heart [27]
- Nothing compared to this specific October 9, 1982 performance at Frost [17]
- The audience version is cited as the best recording of this show [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd82-10-09.sbd.samaritano.23730.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard->Cassette Master(MA-R90/Dolby B)->1st Generation Cassette(XLII-S90/Dolby C).1st Generation Cassette->Fostex D5 (pass-through only)->ZA2->Samplitude… [1]. Also: Transfer, editing, and SHN by Joe Samaritano using ZA2 and Samplitude [1]
- **gd1982-10-09.mtx.seamons.93811.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: SBD/AUD Matrix Mix [2]. Also: Matrix by Hunter Seamons; transfers by Charlie Miller; Rango Keshavan recorded [2]
- **gd1982-10-09.167455.shure.sm57.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Ken Kelley; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Ken Kelley's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > JVC KD-2 w/Super ANRS (Maxell XLII-S90) [3]
- **gd82-10-09.sonyecm.clugston.5183.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sony ECM-220T mics > Sony TC-D5M > DAT > CDR [5]. Also: Identified as Rango's audience recording, which the reviewer believes was done well [18]
- **gd1982-10-09.nak700.anon-poris.LMPP.95656.flac16**: taped by anonymous taper and Jamie Poris; transferred by Brian Green and Evan K.; source: 3 Nak 700's (L & R Cardiods, Center Omni - 3 DB Low Pass filter) 25 foot back, Dead Center > -15 db pads > 3 mic mixer Preamp> Patchbay > Sony D5 > MAC (Dolby… [7]
- **gd82-10-09.sbd-patched.wiley.15800.sbeok.shnf**: source: Main Source A : SBD>MR>PCM>DAT>CD-R [12]

- Poster by Paper Moon, il negozio on-line della tua musica: [GRATEFUL DEAD - Frost Amphitheatre, Palo Alto, Ca. October 9 1982 | 0634359785310](https://www.papmoon.com/grateful-dead-frost-amphitheatre-palo-alto-ca-october-9-1982_39096.html) [29]
- Fan art by www.deadlistening.com: [1982 October 9 - Frost Amphitheatre](https://www.deadlistening.com/2010/07/1982-october-9-frost-amphitheatre.html) [30]
